svg.aria-label: Stack. Backend: Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Spring Cloud Gateway, Spring AI, WebSocket/STOMP, Maven. Dados e infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, Flyway, Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, Git, Linux. Frontend: React, TypeScript, Angular, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Thymeleaf, Bootstrap. Qualidade: JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, JaCoCo, Swagger/OpenAPI. Também usei: Python (FastAPI), Node.js (Express, Prisma).
